purpose: Status-bearing mechanics output. Regional geometry is generated by a deterministic development solver; absolute target force is withheld unless SD-04 is approved.

decision.consequence: All public force evaluations and exports are not_evaluated and carry force_pN: null. The numerical laws may be used only for deterministic development geometry and implementation parity audits.

sensitivity.label: parameter sensitivity range
sensitivity.interpretation: SD-04 provides no reviewer-approved parameter ranges or covariance policy. Emitting a min/max band would manufacture uncertainty. This is neither a confidence interval nor biological population variance.

physics.topology: The four modeled I-band regions share one development-solver force. The unresolved post-N2A interval has no approved contour or force law and is excluded from mechanics.

equations.folded_plus_wlc: z = rigid_folded_length + WLC_extension(f, A, Lc - rigid_folded_length)
